slides.title: Faith and Festivals
slides.text: Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, the Islamic New Year and the Prophet's Birthday bring both countries together. In Ramadan the table is set with dates and sweets, and children celebrate: in Bahrain on Gargee'an night in colourful costumes, and in Tunisia at family gatherings with brik, zlebia and assidat zgougou at Mouled.
